chapter.verse: Topa in na hong sep hun hong tung ding hi. Jerusalem khuapi kiluh gawpin, note’ muh mahmahin a na lakte uh hawm ding uh hi.

Jerusalem khuapi a sim dingin Topa in minam khempeuh kaikhawm ding hi. A khuapi kila-in, innte kiluh gawpin, numeite zong kibuan ding hi. Mi a lang bang sal-in kipaikhiatpih ding a, a dangte ahih leh kipaikhiatpih lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa hong kuankhia ding a, a beisa hun-a a sim ngei bangin hih minam dangte hong sim ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin Jerusalem nisuahna lama om Oliv Mual tungah Topa ’ ding ding hi. Tua ciangin nisuahna lam pan nitumna lamah Oliv Mual kitamin phel nih suak ding a, a kikalah kuampi om ding hi. A mual kimkhat leilu lamah kikhinin, kimkhat, leitaw lamah kikhin ding hi.
Hinnom kuam sung kivukcip ding a, Judah kumpi Uzziah’ hun lai-a zin lin-a kivukcip mah bang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka Pasian hong pai ding a, a mi siangthote khempeuh hong tonpih ding hi.
Tua ni hong tun’ ciangin khuavak, khuadam, vukkiat cihte om nawn lo ding a,
khuamial hun cih zong om lo ding hi. Zan hun nangawnin sun khuavak bek om ding hi. Hih thu a pian’ ding hun, Topa bek in a thei hi.

Tua ni hong tun’ ciangin Jerusalem khua panin tuiciim hong luang khia ding a, kimkhat, nisuahna lama om Si Tuipi ah luang ding a, kimkhat, nitumna lama om Mediterranean Tuipi-ah luang ding hi. Tua tui in kan’ hun cih nei loin luang tawntung ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa pen leitung khempeuh’ kumpi suak ding a, mi khempeuh in amah bek thei-in bia ding uh hi.

Leilu lam Geba khua panin leitaw lam Rimmon khua dong, leitang khempeuh, zanglei suak ding hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem khuapi pen bangmah ci loin a sangpi-in om ding a, Benjamin Kongpi pan-a kipan, ni danga kongpi a omnasa Kiu Kongpi dong, leh Hananel Tausang panin kumpipa’ leenggahcilna phual ciang dong ban ding hi.
Tua khuapi sungah lungmuang takin mi teeng ding uh a, lauhuaina tuak kha nawn lo ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jerusalem khuapi a sim minam dang khempeuhte tungah Topa in gimna lianpi tungsak ding hi. A khe-un a ding thei kimlai mahin a sa uh muat mang ding a, a mitkhuk sung uhah a mittangte uh muatin, a kam sung uhah a leiite uh muat ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Topa in amaute amkhamsak gawp ding a, mite in a gei-a a mat khak mite manin khat leh khat kilaithang gawp ding uh hi.
Judah mite in Jerusalem khuapi hutna-in galsim ding uh a, minam dang khempeuhte’ neihsa, kham, ngun, leh puante tampi tak laksak ding uh hi.
Galte’ phual-a om sakolte, lasakolte, kalaohte, late, leh ganhing om khempeuh tungah gimna lianpi tung ding hi.

Tua bangin galte a kizawh gawp khit ciangin, galte sung panin a nungta lai mite in Vanglianpen Topa, kumpi ahihna hangin a bia ding, leh ama gualzawhna pawi a bawl dingin kum simin Jerusalem ah pai tawntung ding uh hi.
Minam khatpeuh peuh in Vanglianpen Topa ahi kumpipa a bia dingin Jerusalem ah a pai nop kei leh amau’ gam sungah guahzu lo ding hi.
Tua gualzawhna pawi a bawl dingin Izipt mite a pai nop kei leh, tua bang-a a pai nuam lo minamte’ thuak gimnate mah, amau tungah tung ding hi.
Gualzawhna pawi bawl dingin a pai nuam lo Izipt mite leh minam dangte khempeuh tungah a tung ding gimna in tu-a bang ahi hi.

Tua ni ciangin sakol khilongte khempeuh tungah, “ Topa ’ tungah sian’thona” ci-in ciamtehna kibawl ding hi. Biakinn sunga om beelte khempeuh pen biakna tau mai-a kikoih kuangte mah bangin a siangtho-in kinei ding hi.

Jerusalem khua sung leh Judah gam sunga om beelte khempeuh, Vanglianpen Topa biakna-in zat dingin a tuamin kisiangthosak ding hi. Biakna pia dingin a hong pai mi khempeuh in tua beelte zangin, biakna sa huanna-in nei ding uh hi. Tua ni hong tun’ ciangin, Vanglianpen Topa ’ biakinn ah sumzuak van zuak cihte om nawn lo ding hi.
